findings.description: Target is loc->uri + path.substr(min(path.size(), loc->path.size())) + query. On an exact match the clamped remainder is empty, so GET /api?cmd=whoami emits GET /exec?cmd=whoami HTTP/1.1 - three tokens - and a strict parser runs whoami; bare GET /api runs id. No encoding. Requires a URI naming the route with no trailing space and a strict 3-token reader.
findings.title: The min()-clamped slice leaves the URI intact on an exact match, so an attacker query alone executes a chosen command in a 3-token line

findings.description: A quoted trailing space makes bare GET /api emit GET /exec  HTTP/1.1, four tokens; a whitespace-splitting upstream executes the default command. Requires that config shape and reader.
findings.title: A quoted space in the proxy_pass URI is the separator, so a bare GET /api executes the upstream default command with no encoding
